title: Layout system: Rule of Thirds

spec.rule: Key subjects sit on the intersections of a 3 by 3 grid for dynamic framing.

description: The Rule of Thirds is a standard layout system. Key subjects sit on the intersections of a 3 by 3 grid for dynamic framing. Apply it consistently so pages feel ordered and every element has a clear place.
